title: Notes from inside Kodexa.
lead: This isn't a marketing blog. It's a record of real product, architecture and development decisions we make while building software, our own and for others.
intro: Here we share how we work at Kodexa: the product, architecture and development decisions we make while building software, both our own and for clients. These notes are written from what we actually did, with no invented results.

There are five notes so far. Two tell how we build: Nexo, our digital assistant, and a custom corporate website for a waste management company, with its process explained transparently. The other three are practical guides for deciding and budgeting: how much a website costs, the difference between a website and an application, and when a landing page or a corporate website makes sense.

If you're evaluating a project of your own, these pieces show how we think and what to expect from our process. And if you already have an idea, take a look at our custom web development, custom software and systems, or MVP and SaaS product services, or get in touch directly.
